# NotSoDeFi.com

> Open decentralization metrics for blockchain networks and protocols. Three scores (Chain, Control, Fairness) from fourteen criteria, combining verifiable data with documented editorial assessment. A project of Dreier Labs (Steve Dreier). Not investment advice.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://notsodefi.com/): overview and ranking
- [Projects](https://notsodefi.com/projects): all assessed networks (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Monero, Dogecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Kaspa, Ethereum Classic) with scores
- [Methodology](https://notsodefi.com/methodology): the framework, criteria and weights
- [Calculator](https://notsodefi.com/calculator): compute a score with your own inputs
- [Known problems](https://notsodefi.com/problems): documented limitations across blockchain systems
- [Risk indicators](https://notsodefi.com/risk-indicators): marketing claims versus observable patterns
- [Single points of failure](https://notsodefi.com/spof): SPOF analysis
- [Roadmap tracking](https://notsodefi.com/roadmap-tracking): progressive decentralization timelines
